$comment: Machine-readable record of how Reykjavík's citizen-report form behaves. This file is the source of truth: scripts/send-report.mjs, the Worker adapter and .github/workflows/contract.yml all read it, and the markdown under docs/research/ is generated from it where it repeats these values. Every claim carries how and when it was established, because none of it is documented by the city and all of it can change without notice. Re-verify with: node scripts/verify-facts.mjs
source: black-box probing of the live site; no city documentation exists

submit.notes: No cookie, CSRF token, captcha or Origin check. The ?cat= step is presentational and 308-redirects here.
submit.method_of_verification: curl with an empty payload returned 400 with the validator's own envelope

successResponse.confirmationEmail: from no-reply@reykjavik.is, repeats the number in Icelandic, English and Polish
successResponse.howEstablished: accidentally, by report 110474 — see docs/incidents/2026-08-21-filed-a-real-report.md. Never establish anything this way again.

addressSearch.notes: Staðfangaskrá passed through. We read the registry directly instead — see decisions/0004.

addressInfo.notes: Under /abendingar/, not /location/ beside its sibling. Both params required. Returns an empty array, not an error, for an address the register does not hold.

email.notes: the only way the reporter hears anything back

onlyDescriptionIsEnforced.evidence: an empty POST returns {"error":"Missing required fields","inputErrors":{"description":[…]}} and names nothing else
onlyDescriptionIsEnforced.consequence: the city would accept a report with no coordinate; our relay must reject one
onlyDescriptionIsEnforced.notTested: whether a description-only report actually succeeds — a request that passes validation files a real report

unknownSlugReturns400NotFound404.evidence: a nonsense slug returns 400 with an empty body; an English slug on the Icelandic path returns 400 with a page titled 'Síða fannst ekki (404)'; an empty slug returns 405
unknownSlugReturns400NotFound404.consequence: status alone cannot distinguish a typo'd category from a missing description; the discriminator is 'Missing required fields' plus the category hidden field being re-rendered

noAddressFieldInPayload.evidence: the form's element list carries no address input; the search only moves the map marker, and moving the marker clears the search field
noAddressFieldInPayload.consequence: a thing with no address, which is the case this project exists for, is ordinary usage

map.$comment: A panning limit for the widget, not a jurisdiction check. Read from BrowserMap-*.js, whose filename hash changes on every deploy.

categoryNotes.taxonomyIsFlat: no category hands off to another system; only two carry an informational panel
categoryNotes.nodeIdGapsMeaning: six siblings were created with these and are no longer published; the list is editorial and can grow back
categoryNotes.localeChangesWhatTheCityReceives: the English form at /en/suggestion/send-suggestion/{enSlug} submits category 'Waste bins' and summary 'Suggestion -> Waste bins'. Always post the Icelandic form; the people triaging these read Icelandic.

registry.$comment: The city's address endpoints are Staðfangaskrá unchanged — Laugavegur 1 matched the HMS export to the last decimal, and the city's district '0000' is the registry's SVFNR column. We read the registry ourselves via iceaddr-ts.
registry.jurisdictionRule: reverse-look the coordinate to its nearest address and read SVFNR; anything but 0000 is not Reykjavík's to fix

unknown: maximum upload size and file count — the client sets no maxSize, so the limit is the server's and finding it means uploading until something breaks

backend.$comment: Read passively from the confirmation email's headers. No probing.
backend.system: Drupal, behind the React Router front end
backend.evidence: X-Mailer: Drupal; the category picker carries Drupal node ids; data-drupal-link-system-path appears in the page HTML
backend.legacyHost: abendingar.reykjavik.is 301s to reykjavik.is/abendingar and answers with X-Powered-By: PHP/7.3.33 and PleskLin

measurement.$comment: The follow-through half of the project. The city publishes no report volume and no response times.
measurement.referenceNumberIsACounter: each number a real user's report comes back with is a free sample of the city's total volume; two samples spaced in time give the rate
